hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return $rc } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { rm -rf "$1"; mkdir -p "$1"; }
# Wait for *this script's* background jobs and fail if any failed. wait_all() { local pids=("$@") local rc=0 pid for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do if ! wait "$pid"; then rc=1 warn "Background job failed (pid=$pid)" fi done return "$rc" }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need split need tail need java
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" CHUNK_SIZE="${CHUNK_SIZE:-250m}" # split byte size SPLIT_SUFFIX_LEN="${SPLIT_SUFFIX_LEN:-4}" # avoid "suffixes exhausted" HEAP_GB="${HEAP_GB:-64}" PARALLEL="${PARALLEL:-16}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace # ----------------------------- reset_dir beforeRemoval reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir processing
# ----------------------------- # Auth once # ----------------------------- assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Inputs # ----------------------------- log "Downloading managed inputs: ${managed_inputs}" aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" ./Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Downloading metadata_new_search.json" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" ./metadata_new_search.json --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Creating inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" \ Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
# ----------------------------- # Download + split per study # NOTE: no backgrounding here; ensures split completes before downstream jars. # ----------------------------- download_and_split() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
local s3_src="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/completed/${stdy_id}/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" local dst="beforeRemoval/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv"
log "Downloading ${stdy_id} allConcepts" aws s3 cp "$s3_src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors
if [[ ! -s "$dst" ]]; then error "Downloaded file missing/empty for ready study ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: ${dst}" return 255 fi
log "Splitting ${stdy_id} (~${CHUNK_SIZE} chunks)" # Produces ${dst}.0000, ${dst}.0001, ... (numeric suffix, plenty of space) split -d -a "$SPLIT_SUFFIX_LEN" -b "$CHUNK_SIZE" "$dst" "${dst}." rm -f "$dst"
log "Downloaded and split ${stdy_id}" }
while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed; do # Trim potential quotes/spaces abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]]; then download_and_split "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" else log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id} marked not ready; skipping" fi done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
# ----------------------------- # Download shared inputs (can be parallel) # ----------------------------- pids=()
log "Downloading HRMN_allConcepts.csv" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/hrmn/completed/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/HRMN_allConcepts.csv" --no-progress --only-show-errors & pids+=("$!")
log "Downloading GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv" \ "beforeRemoval/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" --no-progress --only-show-errors & pids+=("$!")
log "Waiting for shared downloads..." wait_all "${pids[@]}"
# ----------------------------- # Run jars # ----------------------------- log "Running RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar" java -Xms32g -Xmx"${HEAP_GB}g" \ -DmaximumPoolSize="$PARALLEL" \ -Djava.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism="$PARALLEL" \ -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError \ -XX:HeapDumpPath=./oom-heapdump.hprof \ -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=gc.log:time,level,tags \ -jar jars/RemoveConsentZeroPatients.jar
log "Running DbGapDataMerge.jar" java -Xmx"${HEAP_GB}g" -jar jars/DbGapDataMerge.jar
# ----------------------------- # Upload output # ----------------------------- log "Uploading result to s3" aws s3 cp "completed/allConcepts.csv" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/allConcepts_data_analyzer.csv" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done"
